description: WHM token and session management, application inventory and legacy API usage reads. Returned credentials, identifiers and URLs are private payload data.

notes.text: Available from cPanel 64.
Requires HTTPS. Names are unique, at most 50 alphanumeric/dash/underscore characters; root cannot use WebPros_Dashboard or WP-Dashboard.

Omitted acl assigns all caller privileges; only caller-held privileges may be assigned. Omitted expiration or zero means no expiration; expired tokens require manual revocation. Omitted whitelist permits any IP.
The returned token is a secret shown only once.
Store the returned credential securely and never log the result.

ACL prose and examples use acl-0/acl-1. Whitelist prose uses whitelist_ip-0/whitelist_ip-1, while later example keys switch to whitelist-ip; the selected underscore spelling follows the attributed 11.138.0.19 source review.

An accepted creation outcome can still raise PayloadMismatchException after the credential was created. Its sensitive unvalidated $payload may contain the only returned secret, but a malformed payload need not contain it. Recover it securely if present and revoke the created named credential through an authorized caller action. Never automatically retry, log the payload or automatically revoke a credential.

Scalars retain their bare field; nonempty sequential string lists emit zero-based acl-0/acl-1 or whitelist_ip-0/whitelist_ip-1. Order, duplicates and empty string items are preserved; empty or malformed lists fail before I/O after metadata reset. No client format checks, implicit read/merge, retry or rollback are added.

No live list acceptance or all-version compatibility is established. Review: https://github.com/hostingpal/whm-api-client/pull/72#pullrequestreview-5722427592.

The token input is the raw secret, not its name.
Recognized tokens return TokenDetails; the unrecognized alternative omits data. TokenDetails has no required fields. Optional nullable fields remain distinct from omission.

token_name.description: The existing API token name. Optional settings may be omitted; rename-only sends token_name and new_name in one request.

acl.description: The complete replacement privilege or nonempty sequential string list, limited to caller-held privileges. Null omits; omitted settings preserve on reviewer-inspected 11.138.0.19 source despite pinned reset prose. Empty strings are supplied values, not preservation sentinels.

whitelist_ip.description: The complete replacement remote IP/CIDR value or nonempty sequential string list; any explicitly clears restrictions. Null omits; omitted settings preserve on reviewer-inspected 11.138.0.19 source despite pinned reset prose. Empty strings are supplied values, not preservation sentinels.

expires_at.description: The optional replacement Unix expiration time; zero explicitly means no expiration. Null omits; omission preserves on reviewer-inspected 11.138.0.19 source despite pinned reset prose. Expired tokens require manual revocation.

new_name.description: The optional new unique name, at most 50 alphanumeric/dash/underscore characters; omission preserves the name. Root cannot use WebPros_Dashboard, WP-Dashboard or Platform360. Null omits; an empty string remains supplied.

notes.text: Available from cPanel 11.40.
Creates a temporary session for cpaneld, whostmgrd or webmaild and the supplied account username or valid email address. The system destroys temporary sessions after 15 minutes of inactivity.

Omitted app is blank and targets cPanel Home; an invalid application still creates a session without linking the application. Omitted locale uses Server Locale; an explicit locale sends a one-year browser cookie. preferredDomain defaults to the server hostname.
cpSecurityToken is a session secret. promptToken contains base64 website-generation goals with maximum decoded length 5000.

Session identifiers, security tokens and URLs are private opaque payload strings; never log them or retrieve the returned URL. cpSecurityToken and promptToken inputs are sensitive when accepted by the operation.
Uses form POST under the client mutation transport policy to keep operation parameters out of access-log URLs.
